title: Goldfish wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a3a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d1f33'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff7b1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9d2e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5e0f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M22 50 Q8 32 6 20 Q18 26 26 38 Q20 44 22 50 Z' fill='url(#tail)'/>
  <path d='M22 50 Q8 68 6 80 Q18 74 26 62 Q20 56 22 50 Z' fill='url(#tail)'/>
  <path d='M22 50 Q14 42 12 33 Q22 38 27 46 Q24 48 22 50 Z' fill='#ffc873' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M22 50 Q14 58 12 67 Q22 62 27 54 Q24 52 22 50 Z' fill='#ffc873' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='50' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='58' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#ffd9a0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M42 29 Q50 14 64 28 Q54 26 42 29 Z' fill='#ff7b1a'/>
  <path d='M44 30 Q50 20 60 29 Q52 27 44 30 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M46 56 Q40 66 48 68 Q52 62 50 56 Z' fill='#ff9d2e'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='60' y='38' width='26' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='41' width='10' height='9' rx='3' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <rect x='75' y='41' width='10' height='9' rx='3' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <rect x='63' y='42' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fe8ff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <rect x='76' y='42' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fe8ff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 58 Q74 62 79 58' stroke='#c24e00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- a few bubbles -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='3' fill='#bfe9ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='20' r='2' fill='#bfe9ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#bfe9ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
